v-hc-md.body:
Hi {first},

I'm a finance sophomore at Iona University in New York (3.9 GPA), and I work overnight shifts as an EMT in the Stamford Hospital ER, so I see the provider side of healthcare up close. Your healthcare work at {firm} is the side of finance I most want to learn.

Would you have 10 minutes for a call? Happy to work around the time difference.

{signature}
